remarks:
Welcome Home! Spacious and beautifully updated first-floor, 2-bedroom, 2-bath condominium with a garage, located in the sought-after Cloister Square Condominiums!

This bright and inviting unit features a large, open kitchen with all new appliances purchased in 2025. The sun-filled living room flows seamlessly into the dining room, complete with sliding glass doors leading to a covered porch—perfect for relaxing and enjoying the outdoors.

The spacious primary bedroom offers a walk-in closet and private bath, while an additional large walk-in closet off the hallway provides plenty of extra storage.

Numerous recent improvements include new luxury vinyl plank flooring (10/2025) in dining room, living room, both bedrooms, hallway and walk in closets, fresh interior paint in neutral tones, new kitchen appliances (2025), new central air conditioning (5/2026), new furnace (4/2026), and new hot water tank (2/2026) plus newer windows and updated baths.

Enjoy the convenience of two entrances—one providing access to the pool and courtyard, and a rear entrance offering easy access to ample parking and the garage. Additional amenities include a generously sized private storage room in the basement and coin-operated laundry facilities.

Ideally situated in a desirable Amherst location, just minutes from shopping, restaurants, and everyday conveniences.

Nothing to do but move right in!

Showings begin Sunday, October 18th, at the Open House.
